svg.text: Colour is never alone: every state also differs in shape, glyph or number. Red = recording, creme = sounds, grey hollow = muted, orange = target of the big button, lumen = the machine’s own will.
THE BIG BUTTON (“Hauptknopf”) – acts on press-down; holding it = the same action only while held

svg.text: A KREIS (one loop) – tap acts on release, quantised; long-press (0.5 s, a filling ring) opens its card; vertical drag = level

svg.text: STATE MACHINE (Kette mode, the default) – Rückgängig undoes the last step from any state and cancels anything pending
die besten Takte, die gerade endeten, werden ein Kreis
